title: Chapter 22: The Xuan Ice Technique
paragraphs: Her long hair cascaded over her shoulders, framing her icy, jade-like features—Yan Bingxuan.
With a backpack slung over her shoulder and a book in hand, she entered the library and met Chen Mobai head-on. Her head tilted slightly, as if in mild surprise.
"I forgot my textbook and came to borrow one," Chen Mobai blurted out, feeling inexplicably self-conscious under her clear, spring-like gaze.
Yan Bingxuan glanced at theFive Elements Artmanual in his hand, her crystalline pupils narrowing slightly in puzzlement.
Hadn't this basic cultivation method been fully taught in the first year of high school?

But Yan Bingxuan had no intention of probing Chen Mobai's motives. She lifted her snow-white, delicately rounded chin, gave a curt nod in acknowledgement, and strode past him to the female teacher managing the book borrowing and return desk.
"Returning this book."
As the two words left her lips, Chen Mobai turned his head and caught a glimpse of the book she was returning.
Frost Condensation Method!
The very cultivation method Old Man Ding had mentioned—the one that could transform a Spiritual Root into an Ice Spiritual Root.

"Finally returning it? You've had this book for almost a year now," the female teacher with round-framed glasses said teasingly as she accepted theFrost Condensation Method. Yan Bingxuan, rarely seen smiling, revealed a fleeting hint of amusement, like spring rain melting winter frost. Chen Mobai, who had only ever witnessed Great Beauty Yan's icy demeanor over the past year, was struck by her radiant transformation.
"I heard you're dropping out. Have you made a firm decision?"
The teacher asked casually while processing the return, causing Chen Mobai's heart to stir. He suddenly sensed he understood the true reason behind Yan Bingxuan's withdrawal.
Yan Bingxuan replied with a single word, but her unwavering conviction shone like a winter plum blossom blooming against the frost, dazzling and peerlessly beautiful.
For the first time, Chen Mobai truly felt the captivating charm of his classmate.

It wasn't her aloof aura, like a snow lotus blooming atop a mountain peak, nor her striking figure beneath her cold demeanor, which seemed far too mature for a high school student. Instead, it was her unwavering belief in her chosen path.
This unwavering determination, this willingness to risk everything and move forward relentlessly once she had made up her mind!
No wonder she was such a top student, reaching the Seventh Layer of Qi Refinement at just eighteen years old.

With such unwavering resolve, even if her Spiritual Root aptitude were poor and she failed to get into university, being assigned to the frontier war effort would ultimately lead to her success, right?
Just as Chen Mobai was thinking this, the female teacher had completed the refund procedures for theFrost Condensation Methodand handed Yan Bingxuan her student ID.
"I don't need it anymore," Yan Bingxuan said, casting a lingering glance at the ID before shaking her head and turning to leave.
As she reached the doorway, her eyes met Chen Mobai's. After a moment's hesitation, she nodded slightly, a silent farewell to their brief half-year of camaraderie as classmates.
They hadn't been in the same class during their first and second years of high school, only being assigned together when they chose their specializations in their final year.
It was a small yet significant connection, perhaps.

"Once you reach the Seventh Layer of Qi Refinement, you can abandon theFive Elements Artand switch to a cultivation method more suited to your Spiritual Root attribute. What did you choose?" Chen Mobai suddenly asked.

After learning about Spiritual Root enhancement methods from Old Man Ding, he had researched the topic extensively online. He knew that while these techniques were classified as methods, they leaned more toward spells.
Cultivators require prolonged, persistent cultivation, and sometimes even a month of diligent practice may yield no improvement in their Spiritual Root attribute points.

Many pioneers advise cultivators to seek out a Cultivation Method aligned with their Spiritual Root. This approach allows them to maintain their cultivation level while synergizing with the Spiritual Root Enhancement Technique, offering a win-win scenario.
"Profound Ice Art," Yan Bingxuan answered reflexively, then realized, "Why did I even answer that?"
"Until we meet again."

Hearing her response, Chen Mobai's initial impulse to offer her theBlackwater Artfaded. Since she had already committed to this path, she must have planned everything meticulously. Even if she hadn't, her parents would certainly have prepared for her.
TheProfound Ice Artwas clearly designed for those with Ice Spiritual Roots. It seemed his concern had been unwarranted.
Watching Yan Bingxuan's retreating figure, Chen Mobai turned back.
"Can I borrow this book?"

The female teacher with round-framed glasses was about to place theFrost Condensation Methodback on the shelf when Chen Mobai's voice stopped her. She hesitated, pointing to the book in her hand. "This one?"
"This is a Section A book. Students need a slip from their major subject teacher to borrow it."

Upon hearing this, Chen Mobai nodded slightly, recalling Old Man Ding's words. While there were indeed numerous Spiritual Root Enhancement Techniques, to prevent students with weak self-control from becoming obsessed and wasting precious foundational training time, access to such knowledge was typically restricted until university.
"I understand. Thank you, Teacher."

The female teacher with round-framed glasses had a favorable impression of the polite Chen Mobai. Assuming he harbored feelings for Yan Bingxuan and sought common ground, she felt compelled to offer a word of caution to prevent him from neglecting his cultivation.

"Yan Bingxuan's great-aunt is a Foundation Establishment Completion True Cultivator at the Natural Palace. Rumor has it she's about to attempt Golden Core Formation. This is a perilous trial with uncertain prospects, so she intends to cultivate a successor beforehand. Yan Bingxuan is one of the candidates. If she masters the Frost Condensation Method and manifests an Ice Spiritual Root, she'll almost certainly be chosen."

Chen Mobai paused, realizing the teacher had misunderstood his intentions. However, he recognized her well-meaning advice—that a young man should prioritize cultivation first. If he successfully achieved Foundation Establishment, he would have over a century to pursue personal aspirations at his leisure.
"Foundation Establishment Completion, huh? There probably isn't even one in all of Danxia City."

Though the Immortal Sect had an orderly succession and represented a civilization of immortal cultivation, it couldn't escape the effects of agglomeration. Talented cultivators seeking further advancement inevitably flocked to the great Grotto-Heaven cities, drawn by their high-tier Spiritual Veins.

Danxia City, despite boasting two major academies and a rare Fourth-Tier Fire Spiritual Vein, attracted few long-term residents beyond Foundation Establishment cultivators whose cultivation had reached its limits.
This was especially true for cultivators at Foundation Establishment Completion, those on the cusp of Golden Core Formation.

"Our city may lack Foundation Establishment Completion cultivators, but we have two Golden Core Venerables," the female teacher, a native of Danxia City, couldn't help but remark in response to Chen Mobai's sigh.

Indeed, among the Immortal Sect's Seventy-Two Blessed Lands, some lacked even a single Golden Core Venerable to oversee them. Yet Danxia City boasted two such venerables, each presiding over one of its major academies: the Scarlet Robe Venerable, a prodigal son who had returned home in glory, and Venerable Shiqing, who utilized Danxia City's Fire Spiritual Vein to refine magical artifacts.
"If only I could hear a lecture from a Golden Core Venerable just once," Chen Mobai mused. "Hearing just one might give me the confidence to finally attempt Foundation Establishment."

The female teacher had also reached the Ninth Layer of Qi Refinement Completion, but she had never dared to attempt Foundation Establishment. If a Golden Core Venerable had simply told her she could succeed, she might have mustered the courage to break through.
But Golden Core Venerables held such lofty status—they were practically gods in Danxia City!
Even students from the two great academies rarely had the opportunity to meet one, let alone a mere high school teacher like her.
Just then, the school bell rang.
Chen Mobai immediately excused himself, grabbed his Five Elements Art manual, and hurried back to class.

He put on his wireless earbuds, opened the Five Elements Art lecture video he had downloaded offline the previous night, and, to avoid being seen by his desk mate, disconnected his phone from the network, turned off the screen, and hid it under his textbook.
Venerable Qingping's slightly rambling voice filled his ears as Chen Mobai's fingers swiped precisely across the screen without looking.
Fast forward!
